blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines’ foreign exchange reserves fell to a nearly four-year low in October, extending their yearlong decline as the peso weakened, foreign debt obligations mounted and gold prices declined. Preliminary data from the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) showed that the country’s gross international reserves (GIR) slid 11.7 percent year-on-year to $97.4 billion. […]...
